## What

Change the emitted verdict `kind` value: `src/rebar/llm/contracts.py:116`,
`src/rebar/schemas/completion_verdict.schema.json:26,49`, and
`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md:224` (plus its "Criterion kinds" section).

## Ordering constraint

BLOCKED BY S2. The reader must accept both values before the emitter changes, or the audit page
mis-renders one generation of records. The `kind` field is an unconstrained `"type": "string"`
with no enum, so a mismatch fails SILENTLY rather than raising.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The verifier prompt instructs `codebase-verifiable` or `non-codebase`.
- [x] `contracts.py` and the JSON schema describe the same two values.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_audit_completion_v2.py` and
      `tests/unit/test_audit_ticket_page_heldout.py` cover the new value AND retain a legacy
      `operator-attested` fixture proving old records still render.
- [x] The `completion-verifier` eval spec passes; eval case ids remain stable or are renamed
      deliberately.
